heroHeadline: War Powers 60-Day Deadline Passes as Congress Defers; TrumpIRA.gov EO Signed; Scotch Tariffs Lifted for King Charles State Visit
heroSubtitle: May 1 (Day 63 of the Iran war) marked the expiration of the War Powers Resolution 60-day deadline — Congress did nothing, with Republicans leaving for recess rather than forcing an authorization vote; Democrats are exploring a lawsuit and Sen. Kaine rejected the administration's claim that the ceasefire pauses the WPR clock. CENTCOM separately filed a request for Dark Eagle hypersonic missiles after Iran moved launchers out of existing US strike range. Trump signed an executive order creating TrumpIRA.gov, a retirement savings comparison platform for ~50 million workers without employer plans (operational by Jan 2027). King Charles III and Queen Camilla visited the White House for a state visit; Trump lifted Scotch whisky tariffs in their honor as part of the US-UK Economic Prosperity Deal. Trump threatened to withdraw US troops from Italy and Spain over European criticism of his Iran strategy — a move constrained by the NDAA's 75,000-troop floor in Europe. The administration also recalibrated its mass deportation push as new data revealed the FBI had diverted more than 9,000 agents to immigration enforcement.
